paragraphs: Just good is not good enough for us. Our Facilities are well maintained and clean. This includes not only our big exciting pool areas but also toilets and showers.

We at Camping Benisol are happy to make your stay a pleasant and fun experience. Our Team is ready to help you out in any way.
Questions? Just Contact us!
Check out our Checkin! A warm welcome and easy start to your vacation are guaranteed with us. We guide you to your plot which comes in different sizes, also adequate for XXL Camping.
Find your favorite spot in one of four different sizes. Check out our special plans for long term booking or staying over winter.

Experience your holiday at our camping in Benidorm. The metropolis of the Costa Blanca, nestled between mountains and sea, offers both relaxed beach holidays and exciting leisure activities. At the same time, you can reach surrounding tourist destinations and the airport in Alicante in a short time. Enjoy this landscape under the Spanish sun all year round at the campsite in Benidorm. In addition to comfortable accommodation, we offer modern and well-kept facilities, comprehensive customer service and an entertainment programme – for holidaymakers and permanent campers.
